newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet, Telecom Italia rise in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Stet, Telecom Italia rise in Milan.

text.p: Shares in Italian state telecoms holding Stet and its telephone operating unit Telecom Italia surged at the opening of the Milan stock exchange.

The Italian Treasury said on Friday it would replace the top two executives at Stet as it prepares the company for privatisation later this year. It also said the conglomerate would absorb Telecom Italia as part of a plan to streamline management within the group.
At 0915 GMT, Stet was up 1.74 percent at 8,020 lire ($5.03) after an early 8,100 high. Telecom Italia was 3.02 percent higher at 4,680 lire against an early 4,700 high.
Full terms of the fusion are expected to be completed by end-August with the much delayed privatisation of one of the world's largest telecoms groups now scheduled by end-October.
